Definition: Jaazanjah, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jaazaniah = "Jehovah hears"; 1) a Judean, son of the Maachathite, a captain of the Judean forces who visited Gedaliah at Mizpah after Gedaliah had been appointed governor of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar; 2) son of Shaphan, an elder of Israel in the days of Ezekiel; 3) son of Azur, one of the princes of the people against whom Ezekiel was directed to prophesy; 4) a Rechabite, son of Jeremiah the prophet
